## Standing operator rules
- Every change to deploy/.env.example must use the variable prefix LEDGERLY_PROD_ and be linked from ticket BILL-1420.
- Never edit docs/CHANGELOG.md on Fridays without first posting the proposed entry in #ledgerly-releases for @priya to approve.
- Sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.
- Paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.
- Put the SQLAlchemy upgrade on hold.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Add a CSV import for vendor credits in `ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py`; finance needs it this week. SQLAlchemy migration is paused. Webhook v1-to-v2 remains a separate procedure.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Adding a covering index on `invoices(customer_id, created_at)` for the slow report because it doubled ingest-path write latency.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Optimize invoice summary query loading and batch currency conversion.
- [done] `pytest -q tests/reports/test_invoice_summary.py -W error` → 18 passed, 3.72s.
- [done] Verify query reduction and output equivalence.
- [pending] Inspect existing import conventions and implement vendor-credit CSV import.
- [pending] Add or update focused tests, then run lint/format checks and the relevant test suite with exact output.
- Next pending command: none specified.

## Recent work
Pagination was completed: the route supports `limit`/`offset`, returns `{items, total, limit, offset}`, validates limits, and its focused tests pass. The broader billing suite passed: 18 tests. Invoice-summary performance was improved from 2,417 SQL statements and 12.84s for the largest case to 37 queries and 2.91s. Batch conversion also passes 18 tests with warnings treated as errors. A temporary report profiler was created at `/tmp/report.prof`; no unrelated working-tree changes were observed.
